objective: Test whether causal candidate-stock morphology plus market state can prospectively route frozen Defensive opportunities to A, B, or OTHER.
selection: highest training balanced domain-classification accuracy; ties prefer fewer rules then lexical order
validation: six leave-one-bear-out folds; thresholds and router selected on five episodes only and applied unchanged to sixth
interpretation: This is a router-discrimination test, not portfolio promotion. Failure rejects this finite router family; success still requires frozen portfolio integration and exact daily MTM.
